title: Psychology, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Pattern B / brand-new -- University Park has no separate Psychology B.A. or B.S. degree-plan file built in this repo at all (checked: no PSYCH-*.json anywhere in degree_plans/), so there is no UP sibling to compare against; this is Behrend's own real, independently-researched curriculum, confirmed 2026-08-27 via direct fetch of bulletins.psu.edu/undergraduate/colleges/behrend/psychology-bs/. No 'BH' suffix applied (same reasoning as the sibling PSYCHBA-2026.json -- no existing UP 'PSYCH' code to disambiguate from; matches the plain-code convention already used for single-non-UP-campus majors like SUR-2026.json). Shares the same core requirements as PSYCHBA (Prescribed: PSYCH 100/301W/406W/489; Additional Required: ENGL 15/30H, PSYCH 200 or STAT 200, CAS 100A/B/C, ENGL 202A/B/C/D; the same 5-category Content Area pool, modeling the same 4-of-5 simplification documented in PSYCHBA-2026.json's own notes) but drops the B.A.'s World Language/B.A. Fields/World Cultures requirements in favor of a mandatory Option track (18cr, choose one of Data Analytics, Human Factors and Design, Psychology in the Workplace, or Science) plus a real 'Quantification' supporting-course requirement (3cr) and a slightly larger practicum pool (PSYCH 294/296/477/494/495/496, vs. the B.A.'s 294/296/494/495/496 -- PSYCH 477 is real and BS-only per the bulletin's own supporting-courses table). Modeled the Science Option (Select 3cr from PSYCH 253/256/260A/261, plus 15cr of 'science-related courses from departmental list') since -- like the BA's content-area simplification -- it's the only one of the four that doesn't require citing an unpublished cross-department 'approved list' full of specific DA/engineering/business course numbers this repo has no independent way to verify (Data Analytics needs DA 101/201W, a department this repo doesn't otherwise load; Human Factors and Psychology-in-the-Workplace both cite 'departmental lists' of engineering/business courses with no enumerated codes given anywhere in the bulletin). The Science Option's own 15cr 'science-related courses from departmental list' is itself unenumerated by the bulletin, so it's left as 5 generic, unenumerated slots -- same 'never fabricate' judgment call used throughout this repo for genuinely unpublished course lists. Real major total per the bulletin: 73cr (Prescribed 12 + Additional Required 13 + Content Areas 12 + Quantification 3 + Practicum 3 + Additional Psychology 3 + 400-level 9 + Option 18 = 73, matches exactly). Bulletin states 120 minimum credits (suggested plan shown totals 122); 13 of the 45 Gen Ed credits (the 4 GQ + 9 GWS already satisfied by PSYCH 200/STAT 200 and ENGL 15/CAS 100/ENGL 202) are embedded in the major total above, not double-counted. Reused the MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 real prerequisite-chain fix already established for PSYCHBA-2026.json (and MATH-2026.json, PLSC-2026.json, SECED-2026.json before it) since PSYCH 200's own real enforced prerequisite is 'PSYCH 100 and MATH 21' (confirmed via bulletins.psu.edu/university-course-descriptions/undergraduate/psych/, 2026-08-27) and STAT 200 shares the same real MATH 21 prerequisite. Entrance to major requires 2.0 GPA and third-semester classification, not modeled directly.
